QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Edelstein Dispatch Report
QuestInfo.0: Report to Neinheart about the events in Edelstein.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Wings' goals are still a mystery, and the Resistance hasn't gotten any friendlier. Neinheart advises you to take heart, and not to be afraid of criticism. The Empress wants to speak to you next...
QuestInfo.2: The battle with the Black Wings has just begun. The Empress wants you to continue on, to confront the vast darkness that is approaching.
